disclaimer: Dates below are transcribed from each project's own published support schedule as of 'asOf'. Schedules can be revised by the vendor after that date — always check 'source' before treating a date as current, and treat this file as something to keep updated (it is a plain local JSON file you can edit), not a live feed.

noFixedScheduleNotes.note: WordPress core does not publish a fixed end-of-life date per version; the project backports security fixes to old branches on a best-effort basis. Treat any specific EOL date claimed for a WordPress version as unverified.

jQuery has no formal EOL schedule. Versions before 3.4.0 are affected by a well-known prototype-pollution/XSS issue (CVE-2019-11358); versions before 3.5.0 have other documented XSS issues. Treat these as 'known issues in old versions', not a vendor-declared EOL.
